en.quote: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
en.riddle: Wilt thou not shew us what thou meanest by these?
en.speaker: children of thy people

he.quote: וְכַֽאֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּנֵי עַמְּךָ לֵאמֹר הֲלֽוֹא־תַגִּיד לָנוּ מָה־אֵלֶּה לָּֽךְ
he.speaker: בְּנֵי עַמְּךָ
